policies.title: Malagasy ordinary passports: Grenada advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy nationality schedule places Madagascar in its Prior to Arrival cohort, requiring a visa from a Grenadian mission or consulate before travel.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Malagasy passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Grenada's schedule defines Prior to Arrival as a visa obtained at a Grenadian mission or consulate before travel.
The actively linked schedule was updated April 2024 and should be rechecked if Grenada publishes a replacement.
Work, study, residence, transit, crew, diplomatic, official, service and special-document routes are outside this classification.

policies.title: Malagasy ordinary passports: Panama visitor visa waiver
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy nationality schedule lists Madagascar among visitors who do not require a visa for stays of up to three months.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Malagasy passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Panama's no-visa-required list sets a maximum visitor stay of three months.
Work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, special-document and final-admission rules remain outside scope.
